lines.text: David gathers thirty thousand chosen men to bring the ark from Abinadab's house on a new cart.
At the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah takes hold of the ark and God strikes him down, so David names the place Perez-uzzah.
David fears the LORD and takes the ark to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite, where it stays six months.
David brings the ark up with rejoicing, dancing before the LORD in a linen ephod, and his daughter Michal despises him.
David offers sacrifices, blesses the people, and gives each a loaf, a date cake and a raisin cake, and Michal rebukes him for dancing.
